CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 14

6. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 15
   C. 5
   D. 11

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

10. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 36
   D. 6

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 77
   D. 22

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

24. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
